value.rationale: A natural orientation-reversal operation on intrinsically flat quotient surfaces orders their entire uniform random pair-distance distributions. The exact all-aspect-ratio mean-square gap, its strict normalized monotonicity and sharp fourth-order threshold quantify a nonorientability effect rather than an arbitrary numerical moment. The fourth-order crossover separates regimes of cross-seam transverse displacement and is absent from an untwisted circle factor; this exact classification is a motivated inverse/integral-geometric benchmark.
